goal: Enforce strict truth in route snapping: a straight line is never snapped, and snap all 2026 travel legs to real streets

steps.description: Fix static/app.js: only show Snapped Route and thick/solid line if has_snapped_path === 1 and path_points.length >= 3
Harden api/routes/timeline.py: enforce non-collinear curve check (has_snapped_path strictly 0 for straight lines)
Snap 291 unsnapped 2026 travel legs (including 2026-09-28) to real OpenStreetMap road curves using OSRM
Cleanse timeline_viewer.db: reset has_snapped_path = 0 on all straight/collinear paths
Verify API contracts, test suite, and live server on https://mylifebits.local/?date=2026-09-28
